system_overview: This specification models an age-tracking communication channel for a partially synchronous distributed system, based on the failure detector framework of Chandra and Toueg (1996). Messages in transit are wrapped in boxes that track how long each message has been traveling. The channel supports picking up new messages, delivering messages to recipients, and aging all in-transit messages at each tick of an environmental clock.
actors_and_components: The communication channel itself is the primary component. It interacts with processes that send and receive messages. Messages are wrapped in boxes that carry both the message content and an age counter indicating how many environmental clock ticks the message has been in transit. The channel is parameterized by a set of all possible messages and a set of possible boxes.
state_variables: The system tracks two pieces of state: (1) The set of all message boxes currently in transit, where each box contains a message and an age counter. (2) The set of messages being delivered to a process in the current transition (these are the unpacked message contents, without age information).
initial_state: No boxes are in transit (empty set). No messages are being delivered (empty set).
actions: Three operations are defined: (1) Pickup: Given a set of messages to send, each message is packaged into a box with age zero and added to the set of in-transit boxes. The delivery set is cleared. (2) Deliver: A subset of in-transit boxes destined for a given receiver is nondeterministically chosen. The messages from those boxes are unpacked and placed in the delivery set, and the delivered boxes are removed from the in-transit set. (3) Attain age: At each tick of the environmental clock, every box still in transit has its age incremented by one. The delivery set is cleared.
safety_properties: Type invariant: The set of in-transit items must be a subset of the valid box type (containing message content and integer age). The set of delivered items must be a subset of the valid message type.
additional_assumptions: This module is designed to be instantiated by a controller module that defines the concrete message and box types and orchestrates the interactions between processes and the channel. The age tracking enables enforcement of message delay bounds in a partial synchrony model.
